samples.question: The dark-bordered square panel is divided into a 7 by 7 grid of equal square cells. Every cell is packed edge to edge with a fine speckle of exactly two inks, warm orange and cool blue, and different cells use different orange-to-blue area ratios. Carry out this operation on the panel: for each of the 49 cells, compare the total area of warm orange ink inside that cell with the total area of cool blue ink inside the same cell, and mark the cell if warm orange covers more than half of it. The small speckled square below the panel is an exactly half-and-half reference mixture. The marked cells form one symbol on the 7 by 7 grid: 'plus' is a full centre row plus a full centre column, 'ex' is both full diagonals, and 'tee_up', 'tee_right', 'tee_down' and 'tee_left' are a full edge line plus a full centre stem running away from that edge towards the opposite side. Gray blocks outside the panel are decoration. Which symbol do the marked cells form? Answer with exactly one of: plus, ex, tee_up, tee_right, tee_down, tee_left.
